The company operates in seven business segments including smart home, industrial technology, building technologies, robotics and automation, energy, healthcare, and smart logistics. Midea's strategic focus includes "Technology Leadership, Direct to Users, Digitization & Intelligence Driven, and Global Impact." The company has invested nearly 60 billion RMB in R&D over the past five years, holds over 80,000 patents, and operates 41 R&D centers and 43 production bases in over 200 countries and regions. Midea's product range includes air conditioning, refrigeration, laundry, kitchen appliances, and smart home technology, all designed with optimal core functionality, thoughtful design, trusted quality, smart value, and eco-conscious principles.. With “Bring Great Innovations to Life” as its corporate vision, “Integrate with the World, to Inspire Your Future” as its mission, and “Embrace what’s next - Aspiration-Dedication-Collaboration-Innovation” as its val-ues, Midea integrates global resources and promotes technological innovation to create a better life for over 400 million users, major customers and strategic partners in different areas worldwide every year with satisfying products and services. In face of higher requirements for products and services in the digital Internet era, Midea has upgraded its strategic focus to “Technology Leadership, Direct to Users, Digitization & Intelligence Driven, and Global Impact” in 2020, so as to rebuild Midea in the new era. The company also provides water treatment products such as water heaters and water dispensers, floor care devices like vacuum cleaners, and small appliances including air coolers, air purifiers, and electric fans. Midea's product range extends to smart home systems and HVAC systems, with services like installation, repair, and customer support available.
